newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bhuwanatala said in 150 bln rph bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Bhuwanatala said in 150 bln rph bond issue.

text.p: Indonesian property company PT Bhuwanatala Indah Permai plans a 150 billion rupiah bond issue and will list a subsidiary to finance the purchase of five property projects, Bisnis Indonesia reported on Tuesday.
The newspaper quoted Bhuwanatala managing director Heru C. Pramono as saying that the plan was subject to shareholder approval at the next general meeting in June.
"We are likely to sell a 30 percent stake in one of our subsidiaries to the public and issue 150 billion rupiah in bonds," Pramono was quoted as saying.

Pramono said the five property projects include two office blocks in Jakarta, another in the Central Java town of Semarang, a three-star hotel in the city of Surabaya and a larger stake in the Dharmo housing project in Surabaya.
